brief-01-arrival: All stations, this is EXCON. Morning, everyone. I'm your SOC manager for Silent Ridge. Get settled, and let's take the watch. We're picking up at zero-nine-three-zero Zulu, exercise time. Patrol LANTERN is already in the field. We suspect its movement details have been disclosed. No harm is confirmed. We need a careful assessment of what happened and what needs attention. Your evidence comes from endpoints, network traffic, identity records, document services, and security monitoring exports. Work together. Share the source behind a finding, your confidence in it, and the uncertainty that still matters. If another cell sees it differently, hear them out. Changing your mind when the evidence changes is part of the job. I'd rather you raise a useful question early than leave the next cell guessing. Keep this read-only. Preserve the evidence. Do not contact, track, or direct real personnel. No attack is required. Send recommendations to the controller. Command decides any patrol response. All right. Let's get to work. Good hunting. EXCON, out. All names, hosts, addresses and artifacts are fictional exercise material. Nothing here is a real system or person. OPERATION SILENT RIDGE — EXERCISE ONLY.
brief-02-post-lunch: All stations, this is EXCON. Welcome back, everyone. Let's get our heads back in the room. Before we disappear into our own tabs, take a moment with the shared findings. What can you support? What are you still assessing? What remains open? Check the evidence currently available to you. Give another cell a short update: your strongest finding, the source behind it, and the uncertainty that matters most. Let them challenge one claim. Walk them through your reasoning, and revise it if you need to. If you're stuck, say where. Someone else may have the piece you're missing. Agree your next useful step together. Keep the investigation read-only, and send recommendations to the controller. Let's keep each other in the picture. Good hunting. EXCON, out. All names, hosts, addresses and artifacts are fictional exercise material. Nothing here is a real system or person. OPERATION SILENT RIDGE — EXERCISE ONLY.
brief-03-final-approach: All stations, this is EXCON. All right, everyone. Let's bring the pieces together. We've still got time to do useful work. Start shaping the assessment you can defend with the evidence you have. What can you support as disclosed? What remains unproven? If you can't establish something yet, say so. I need to understand how sure you are, and why. Recommend a proportionate containment response. Explain the evidence behind it, an alternative you considered, and the tradeoff for disruption or evidence preservation. What would change your mind? Another cell will challenge your reasoning. Give them room to do that. Work through the challenge, and revise the assessment if it changes your view. Keep this read-only. Send your technical assessment to the controller. Command decides any patrol response. Keep talking to each other. Let's make the remaining time count. Good hunting. EXCON, out.
